text: Oct 21: Lendeborg got the game's only technical, late in the second quarter, for yelling at Dončić. Dončić did not get one; Steve Kerr said he should have. Afterward Lendeborg said he had "lost all respect" for him.
Lendeborg was Dončić's main defender that night: Dončić went 1 of 6 against him and 6 of 12 against everyone else (his 7 of 18 in the box score, minus the 1 of 6).
source: ABC7 News (Oct 22); Land of Basketball box score

text: Since then: 31 points, 12 rebounds and 6 assists at Denver on Oct 26. His 87 points in his first four games are the most by a Warriors rookie since Wilt Chamberlain in 1959.
